subject: Money
title: The Federal Reserve
description: Learn The Federal Reserve in one minute.

hook.text: The Fed was created in secret on Jekyll Island in 1910. Six bankers planned it behind closed doors.

buildup.text: Bank panics in 1907 nearly collapsed the US economy. The country needed a lender of last resort.

discovery.text: The Fed controls money supply, sets interest rates, and acts as banker to banks. It is the system.

twist.text: It's not fully government and not fully private. This hybrid design still generates controversy.

climax.text: The Fed's decisions affect every mortgage, job, and price on Earth. One institution, global reach.

punchline.text: Seven people set the price of money.

quiz.question: Where was the Federal Reserve secretly planned?
